elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed"

reasons: All thirteen atomic elements of the preferred position are present in the inserted subsection (b) read with the existing subsection (a): mutual aggregate cap, greater-of structure with the exact fee basis and claim anchor, USD 1,000,000 floor, the full uncapped carve-out set, and the payment-obligations carve-out.
The mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages is supplied by the untouched original subsection (a), so no duplication was needed.

The insertion is a concise addition of an entirely absent aggregate cap; no existing sentence was rewritten and no new exception, undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced ('Excluded Claims' is defined in place).
Fallback is also satisfied on its material terms, but the locked target is preferred and preferred is complete, so the clause is compliant at the preferred level with no further redline required.
